desk-slack messages draw as they do in Slack again: a `---` under a line and lines indented four spaces no longer turn into a heading or a code box.

- A line followed by `---` (or a `──────` line copied from a terminal) keeps the line as text and draws a rule under it. Since 0.77.0 the line above became a heading
- Lines indented four spaces or more, such as code pasted without a fence, stay text with their indent. Since 0.77.0 a line after a blank line became a code box
- A line of only `=` or `-` that is not a rule stays as typed
- desk-look, desk-asana, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.77.1 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
